asked.item: Credit cost of Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 image-to-video at 1080p
How to see the cost before generating, to budget

verdict.reason: The price table gives the per-second 1080p rate for this model, and the pages explain where to see a cost before generating.

steps.text: The google/gemini-omni-flash/v1.1/image-to-video model costs 50/sec at 1080p, so multiply that rate by your clip length.
To see what a generation will cost, click a GREEN clip (image) or PURPLE clip (video), and the credit cost appears right above the "Regenerate" button.
